phone.allow_done: Done. Open the code on the phone again.
phone.allow_failed: The Windows rule was not changed: {error}
phone.android17: Android 17: allow the browser to access the local network. Settings → Apps → your browser → Permissions → Nearby devices → Allow.
phone.bind_failed: Could not open receiving on this computer. Details: {error}
phone.expired: The code has expired. Show a new code and point the camera again.
phone.finished_note: Reception closed from the phone. The photo is on the computer.
phone.fw_declined: Not allowed. Press “Allow” when you are ready.
phone.fw_failed: The firewall rule could not be changed (code {code}).
phone.fw_nopkexec: This system has no password prompt. Copy the command, run it in a terminal and press “Show code”.
phone.fw_ok: Allowed. Point the camera at the code.
phone.fw_text: The firewall of this computer blocks the phone. Allow photos from your home network: only {count} ClipSD ports will open, and only for devices on your Wi-Fi network.
phone.help_after_title: The phone connected, but the photo did not arrive:
phone.help_android_text: If the browser shows ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES or ERR_LOCAL_NETWORK_PERMISSION_MISSING: Settings → Apps → (your browser) → Permissions → “Nearby devices” → Allow. Chrome and Edge 157 do not ask by themselves, Chrome 158 and newer does: tap “Continue” and turn it on.
phone.help_fw_allow: A firewall is on in this computer. Press “Allow”: the system asks for the administrator password, and only {count} ClipSD ports open, only for your home network.
phone.help_fw_linux: A firewall is on on this computer. Copy the command, run it in a terminal and try again:
phone.help_fw_other: This computer may have another firewall or protection program. Allow incoming connections to ports {ports} from the home network.
phone.help_fw_public: If Windows treats this network as public but it is your home network, make it private: Settings, Network & internet, your network, “Private network”.
phone.help_fw_win: If Windows asked for permission and you refused, press “Allow again”. Windows will ask for an administrator’s confirmation.
phone.help_pcvpn: A VPN on the computer itself usually does not interfere; if nothing helped, turn it off for a minute.
phone.help_r_big: “Photo too large” (over 25 MB): shoot at a normal size or choose another picture.
phone.help_r_expired: “Reception closed” on the phone: the code expired (3 minutes without a phone, or 3 minutes after the last photo). On the computer press “Show a new code”.
phone.help_r_heic: “HEIC format”: the computer cannot open it. In the phone camera settings turn on the most compatible format (JPEG) or choose another picture.
phone.help_r_iphone: iPhone: nothing to allow, Safari and Chrome work. If it does not open, check Wi-Fi and VPN.
phone.help_r_limit: “The window took all the photos”: 20 photos at a time. Press “Show a new code”.
phone.help_r_open: “The computer could not open photo N”: take that photo again.
phone.help_r_taken: “Code already open on another phone”: another phone took the code. Press “Show a new code” and scan it with the right phone.
phone.help_title: The phone has not connected yet
phone.help_vpn_text: A VPN or a blocker such as AdGuard sends the phone’s traffic to the internet, so the phone cannot see the computer on the home network. Turn it off for a minute or allow “local network access” in it.
phone.help_vpn_title: Turn off the VPN or blocker on the phone for a minute
phone.help_wifi_text: The network name must be the same as on the computer. A guest network or mobile internet will not do: if the phone switched to mobile data, turn mobile data off for a minute.
phone.help_wifi_title: Check the Wi-Fi network on the phone
phone.hidden_note: Photo received. You can take another within {minutes} minutes.
phone.hint_android: Phone with Android 17: allow the browser “Nearby devices”: Settings → Apps → (your browser) → Permissions → Nearby devices → Allow. Then scan the code again.
phone.hint_title: Not connecting? Try in this order:
phone.hint_vpn: Turn off the VPN or blocker (AdGuard and similar) on the phone for a minute.
phone.hint_wifi: The same Wi-Fi (not a guest network, not mobile internet) and the firewall of the computer does not block the phone (button “Couldn’t connect?”). iPhone: nothing to allow.
phone.idle: Receiving is closed: no new photos for a long time.
phone.limit: One opening of the window accepts up to {max} photos. Show a new code to take more.
phone.locked: Someone on the network is guessing the code. Receiving is closed, this code no longer works.
phone.manual: Or type in the phone’s browser:
phone.no_network: The computer is not on a home network. Connect Wi-Fi or a cable from the router and press “Retry”.
phone.page_ask_text: Send again or finish without it?
phone.page_bad_type: This is not a photo. Choose a JPEG or PNG picture.
phone.page_camera_note: After the shot the phone camera shows an “OK” button: tap it, then “{end}” or “{more}”.
phone.page_closed: Receiving on the computer is closed. Open “Screenshot/photo from phone” in ClipSD again.
phone.page_done_hint: The photo is on the computer, you can close this tab.
phone.page_expired_unsent: The reception time on the computer has ended and the photo was not sent. On the computer open “Screenshot/photo from phone”, show a new QR code, scan it and send again.
phone.page_failed: The photo did not arrive. Check Wi-Fi: the page tries again, or tap “Send again”.
phone.page_heic: The computer cannot open HEIC photos. Shoot in JPEG (turn on the most compatible format in the camera settings) or choose another photo.
phone.page_intro: A shot from your phone straight to your computer
phone.page_limit: This window has received all the photos it can take at once. Show a new code on the computer.
phone.page_link_lost: No connection to the computer. The window on the computer is closed or the phone left the Wi-Fi network.
phone.page_lost: The page reloaded while the camera was open and the photo was lost. Take it again.
phone.page_lost_n: The page reloaded while the camera was open. Photos that did not get through: {n}. Take them again.
phone.page_offline_text: On the computer open “Screenshot/photo from phone” and scan the new code.
phone.page_offline_title: The connection to the computer is closed
phone.page_pcfail: The computer could not open photo {n}
phone.page_saved: The photo is kept on this phone until the next connection (1 hour).
phone.page_sent: The photo is on the computer
phone.page_sent_more: You can take another within 3 minutes.
phone.page_too_big: The photo is too large. Take it again.
phone.page_unsent: The photo did not reach the computer. If your browser allows it, press and hold the picture to save it to the phone gallery.
phone.page_used: This code is already open on another phone. Show a new code on the computer.
phone.phone_done: Receiving was closed from the phone. To take more photos, show a new code.
phone.photo_late: The photo from the phone was received and opened in the editor.
phone.recv_decode: Photo {n} arrived but the computer could not open it.
phone.recv_failed: The photo did not arrive: the transfer was interrupted. Send it again from the phone.
phone.recv_heic: The photo did not open: HEIC format. Choose JPEG on the phone or turn on the most compatible format in the camera.
phone.step1_cable: The computer is connected to the router by cable, address {address}. Receiving is open.
phone.step1_net: The computer is on the home network, address {address}.
phone.step1_other: The computer is on the home network, address {address}. Receiving is open.
phone.step1_title: The computer is ready to receive
phone.step1_wifi: The computer is on Wi-Fi, address {address}. Receiving is open.
phone.step2_done_text: Take photos: they will open in the editor.
phone.step2_text: The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi network as the computer.
phone.step2_title: Point the phone’s camera at the code
phone.step3_text: The photo opens in the editor right away. You can take several in a row.
phone.title: Screenshot/photo from phone
phone.vpn_hint: A VPN on the phone can block the connection.
phone.wifi_text: The phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Over mobile data the photo will not arrive.
